summary: No thesis broke today. No price stop tripped. No held name has a new 8-K, guidance cut, failed trial, auditor change or confirmed cyber incident in the inputs. The day was broad de-risking with no news behind it: equity fell 0.89% (-$5.58), SPY fell about 1.0% and the shadow about 1.2%, and no held-name headline explains any move. The open WMT 8-K 5.02 question from 11-16 now looks answered: the 11-16 headline 'Walmart Appoints Caterpillar CEO Joe Creed to Board of Directors' matches the filing (document dated 11-13). The match is an inference, but it points to a board appointment, not an executive departure before the print. Two names are tight. VOO and VTI (about 23.4% of equity together) closed only 0.39% above their shared SPY 200-day stop (732.44 vs 729.58), down from about +1.5% this morning, with Nvidia reporting tonight. MCO fell 4.32% to $484.41, 3.07% above its $470 stop, with no MCO item that explains it. Clause by clause: MCO's CIO appointment is a headline with no 8-K 5.02 in the window. Its rating actions (Volvo downgrade; WellSpan and WTW affirmations) and the Philippines forecast cut are the ratings business working as usual. The CFO's JPMorgan-conference remarks today are not in the input. MSCI fell 4.20% the same day with no headline, so the financial-data sleeve sold off as one, as L3 predicts. That looks like a factor move, but the inputs don't confirm it. KR: Stifel initiated at Buy with an $80 target, and the cyber incident is still unconfirmed as Kroger. INCY: no filing since the 11-13 MAESTRA-3 8.01, and guidance is unaffected per the company. EXEL rose 2.1% with no news. SAM was bought at $220.142. Its 11-13 8-K 8.01 is still unread, and the $201 stop is about 8.7% under the fill, not the stored '10% under the menu close', so the restate-from-fill is due next run (L6). VRSN's -0.9% includes the $0.81 ex-dividend drop. DPZ's pizza launch and WMT's China agreement, product placements and charity items are noise. CARG (-3.2%), IDXX (-1.5%), FAST and MSCI have no news or filings.

It decides whether SPY holds 729.58, and so it decides VOO and VTI together (about 23.4% of equity, L9). Sell-side drift is still up (BNP $144). Not held, but inside 5 trading days for any new buy: BLBD about 11-23 (its 11-10 8-K 5.02 is still unread), and ADSK and BBY about 11-24 (file estimates, approximate). Later: UNFI about 12-01 (Goldman upgrade to Buy today, 8-K 7.01), KR 12-03 (company-confirmed), and ADBE about 12-09 alongside the 12-09 FOMC (hikes priced for December and January per 11-16 items). Next dates for held names, from the file: EXEL 2027-01-11 (estimate), FAST 01-19, MSCI 01-27, IDXX 02-01, VRSN 02-04, INCY 02-09, MCO 02-17, CARG 02-18, DPZ 02-22, SAM 02-23. Crypto and the bond, gold and other ETFs had no tagged headline in today's 72-hour input, so there is nothing new on exchange failures, regulation or rates since the 11-16 notes. GLD's 11-24 'earnings' date is a data artifact. Open threads: the WMT 8-K 5.02 is closed as the Creed board appointment (inference). The SAM 8-K 8.01 (11-13) and FTDR 8-K 5.02 (11-12) are still unread. DOJ antitrust review of DoorDash-Instacart raises CART deal-break risk (not held).
